name: web-search
title: Web Search
description: Open a search or URL in a new Helium window, with local history and optional Google suggestions.
author: jonasw

commands.name: search
commands.title: New Browser Window
commands.subtitle: Helium
commands.description: Open a new Helium window with a Google search or URL. Empty input opens a blank window.

preferences.name: enableSuggestions
preferences.title: Google Suggestions
preferences.label: Send what I type to Google for live suggestions
preferences.description: Off by default. When on, each pause in typing sends the text in the search field to suggestqueries.google.com, including text you complete from history. Stored history is never uploaded in bulk.

preferences.name: enableHistory
preferences.title: Local History
preferences.label: Remember what I open on this Mac
preferences.description: Stores searches and bare domains in Raycast local storage. URLs with a query string, fragment, or credentials are never stored.

preferences.name: historyLimit
preferences.title: History Size
preferences.description: Oldest entries are dropped beyond this limit.
